value.rationale: Third cumulants quantify finite-sample skewness of natural degree-based statistics beyond established covariance/normal limits. The all-score exact identity collapses arbitrary joint degree dependence into few binomial finite differences, and the isolated-vertex specialization proves a unique critical sparse intensity (approximately 0.5009753) at which the order-n third cumulant changes sign. These are natural network statistics, not arbitrary parameters.
